blurb: This control checks four CDE desktop programs under /usr/dt/bin (dtaction, dtappgather, dtprintinfo, and dtsession) to confirm none is marked setuid or setgid, a setting that makes a program run with the file owner or group privileges instead of the user who launched it. CDE programs carrying this setting have a history of defects that let an ordinary local user escalate to root. A program left set could therefore hand an attacker with any account on the system full administrative control.
